description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization logic for Web requests and responses, including handling of HTTP headers, content types, encoding, chunked transfer, and WebSocket extensions. It defines classes and methods for converting internal data structures to and from wire format, managing state during parsing and serialization, and handling compression and signature data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods for serialization and deserialization, including handling of headers, body, and transfer states.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for serialization and deserialization, including headers, status, and body.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with type and data.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents an authorization token with type and token string.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request or response into a byte stream for network transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into internal request or response data structures.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a line of text into internal request or response fields during deserialization.

methods.name: EndOfLine
methods.description: Handles the end of a line during parsing, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: EndOfPassThrough
methods.description: Finalizes the current message after streaming data, handling chunked or complete content.
